topics.topic: CLI exit outcome for configuration-loading or storage failures
questions: What closed CLI outcome and exit code applies when configuration loading or bootstrap storage fails?
What process exit behavior is part of the contract when bootstrap cannot load configuration or access storage?
What process exit result is guaranteed when configuration loading or bootstrap storage fails?

quotes: A configuration or storage failure is none of the four outcomes: the operation raises it and returns no exit code, and the failure status the host process then ends with is outside the closed contract of A29.
judgement.why: The operation explicitly guarantees no returned exit code for these failures and leaves the resulting host-process status outside the four-outcome contract.
